text:
lee: Heads upI hit a puzzling embed shape mismatch in the onboarding sampleapp today. FYI this is with the v2 SDK batch helper.

jordan: paste the minimal request/response?

lee: minimal request (redacted):
```json
{"model":"embed-sim-2","inputs":["x","y","z"],"batching":{"async":true,"max_batch_size":4}}
```
response (trimmed):
```json
[{"item_id":"a","embedding":[... 2048 floats ...]},
 {"item_id":"b","embedding":[... 128 floats ...]},
 {"item_id":"c","embedding":[... 2048 floats ...]}]
```

alex: 128?? that's not even a common downgrade size. Could be a legacy model variant. Are you on private/dedicated or hosted?

lee: hosted, us-east. No explicit model aliasing in code. Using sampleapp wrapper: `Embeddings.batchSend(texts)` (no item ids passed).

nina: this looks like two problems: 1) helper doesn't attach stable per-item ids, so async retry can reorder/merge incorrectly; 2) server-side routing returned different model variants for slices of the same logical batch. We should hard-fail merge when dims differ.

alex: +1. I also wonder if auth retry logic in SDK is doing a blind re-POST without preserving batch metadata. If the first call partially succeeded and then retry included a truncated payload, downstream routing might treat it as a separate request.

lee: i grabbed a packet capture from the helper:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
payload: {batch_id: "b-314", items:[{text:"x"},{text:"y"},{text:"z"}]}
--> 500 server error
retry #1: POST /v1/embeddings
payload: {batch_id: "b-314", items:[{text:"x"},{text:"y"}]}
--> 200 ok (serving-model: embed-legacy-128)
200 ok (serving-model: embed-sim-2-2048)
```

jordan: that's super helpful. Two different responses and no per-item identifier mapping in client -> client zipped results mismatch. We need both client and server fixes.

nina: propose immediate actions:
- SDK/Batcher: attach per-item stable ids and `x-idempotency-key` for logical batches by default. Preserve mapping when merging async responses.
- Server: return `model` and `embedding_dim` per item in the response JSON, or reject on mixed dims.
- SDK: add assertion on merge to raise an error if dims differ and surface telemetry to Sentry/telemetry pipeline.

alex: agree. Also add an integration test that simulates partial retry hitting different model backends; CI should fail if dims mismatch is not detected.

lee: temporary workaround for customers: set `batching.async=false` OR pass explicit `item_id`s in the request. Will add note to sampleapp README.

jordan: can someone sketch the response field we want? I propose per-item metadata: `{item_id, embedding, model, embedding_dim}` so clients can verify.

nina: yep that works. Server team: can you add `embedding_dim` in the response payload? cc @eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: note: sampleapp PR #215 opened (fix/batcher-ids) by lee, CI started.

alex: for SDK parity across languages: ensure JS/py/go clients all expose the same batcher options and default to attaching ids. We missed this in the v2 rollout.

lee: I'll land the sampleapp change with a dim-check in the merge code. Then open an SDK PR to add ids+idempotency.

jordan: created GH issue rwi/sdk#502 to track SDK change and rwi/runtime#121 for server dimension metadata.

nina: last thought: rerank endpoint can also suffer if scores are returned in order-of-processing rather than input order when ids are missing. Add a test for rerank where some requests are slow and require retry.

lee: noted, I added a tiny local fix for rerank in staging: map by `item_id` before applying sort. blocked until SDK change lands.

jordan: thanks. follow-ups: SDK PR + runtime PR + sampleapp patch. We'll post a short alert in onboarding docs and close thread after deploy. :rocket:
